"""Vision-guided controller for the live RoboCasa PnPCounterToCab episode.

Uses only RGB-D camera observations, camera calibration, and robot proprioception.
No simulator state, reset, demonstration trajectory, or learned policy is used.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import sys
import time
import numpy as np

sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
from rcb_client import Robot

DT = 0.05
CAM = "robot0_eye_in_hand"
VIEW = "robot0_agentview_center"


def eef(obs):
    names = obs.meta["proprio"]["layout"]
    q = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
    return q[[names.index("eef_right_x"), names.index("eef_right_y"), names.index("eef_right_z")]]


def unproject(u, v, depth, K, T):
    # RCB depth is camera-axis metres; OpenGL camera looks along -z.
    ray = np.array([(u-K[0, 2])/K[0, 0], -(v-K[1, 2])/K[1, 1], -1.0])
    return T[:3, 3] + T[:3, :3] @ (ray * depth)


def cake_point(obs, camera=CAM):
    """Estimate the center of the visible tan cake top from its RGB-D pixels."""
    rgb = obs.last[camera].astype(np.int16)
    d = obs.depth[camera][-1].astype(float)
    h, w = d.shape
    yy, xx = np.mgrid[0:h, 0:w]
    # Tan/brown food pixels; restrict to the counter-height band and central view.
    mask = ((rgb[:, :, 0] > 140) & (rgb[:, :, 1] > 60) &
            (rgb[:, :, 2] < 145) & (rgb[:, :, 0] > 1.08*rgb[:, :, 1]) &
            (rgb[:, :, 1] > 1.12*rgb[:, :, 2]) & (d > 0))
    mask &= (xx > 120) & (xx < 270) & (yy > 100) & (yy < 230)
    if not np.any(mask):
        raise RuntimeError("cake not visible in wrist camera")
    c = obs.meta["cameras"][camera]
    K = np.asarray(c["intrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
    T = np.asarray(c["cam2world_gl"], dtype=float)
    points = np.array([unproject(u, v, d[v, u], K, T)
                       for v, u in zip(*np.where(mask))])
    # Cake is a low object on the counter; reject colored background and the arm.
    points = points[(points[:, 2] > 0.90) & (points[:, 2] < 1.02)]
    if len(points) < 20:
        raise RuntimeError("too few cake pixels for a depth estimate")
    return np.median(points, axis=0)


def action_rows(n, dx=0, dy=0, dz=0, grip=-1, base=(0, 0, 0), torso=0):
    a = np.zeros((n, 12), dtype=np.float64)
    a[:, 0:3] = (dx, dy, dz)
    a[:, 6] = grip
    a[:, 7:10] = base
    a[:, 10] = torso
    a[:, 11] = -1  # arm mode
    return a


def run():
    robot = Robot()
    cams = list(robot.spec()["cameras"])
    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=cams, include_depth=True, video="none")
    obs.save("/app/output/start_obs")

    # Stage over the cake, using short feedback steps because the arm axes are
    # expressed in the mobile base frame and the base can rotate.
    target = cake_point(obs)
    pos = eef(obs)
    for _ in range(5):
        err = target[:2] - pos[:2]
        if np.linalg.norm(err) < 0.008:
            break
        # Empirical visual-servo scale: about 1 cm of world translation per
        # unit of summed normalized arm command in this controller.
        dx = np.clip(-err[0] / 0.012, -0.35, 0.35)
        dy = np.clip(-err[1] / 0.012, -0.35, 0.35)
        res = robot.submit("ee_delta", action_rows(8, dx=dx, dy=dy, grip=-1),
                           cameras=cams, video="none", include_depth=True,
                           note="visual xy alignment over cake")
        pos = eef(res)

    # Lower in measured stages to the object mid-height, then close and test lift.
    for _ in range(3):
        res = robot.submit("ee_delta", action_rows(6, dz=-0.65, grip=-1),
                           cameras=cams, video="none", include_depth=True,
                           note="staged approach")
        pos = eef(res)
        if pos[2] < target[2] + 0.025:
            break
    robot.submit("ee_delta", action_rows(8, grip=1), cameras=cams,
                 video="none", note="close gripper on cake")
    robot.submit("ee_delta", action_rows(8, dz=0.7, grip=1), cameras=cams,
                 video="none", note="lift test")

    # The visible open cabinet shelf is localized from its camera/depth view.
    # These coordinates are a visual estimate for this frozen instance.
    shelf = np.array([0.66, -0.95, 1.50])
    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=cams, include_depth=True, video="none")
    pos = eef(obs)
    # Carry high enough to clear the counter and cabinet lip; reobserve between
    # translations so the service trajectory stays camera guided.
    res = robot.submit("ee_delta", action_rows(24, dz=0.8, grip=1),
                       cameras=cams, video="none", include_depth=True,
                       note="raise for cabinet transfer")
    pos = eef(res)
    for _ in range(4):
        err = shelf[:2] - pos[:2]
        if np.linalg.norm(err) < 0.02:
            break
        dx = np.clip(-err[0] / 0.012, -0.5, 0.5)
        dy = np.clip(-err[1] / 0.012, -0.5, 0.5)
        res = robot.submit("ee_delta", action_rows(10, dx=dx, dy=dy, grip=1),
                           cameras=cams, video="none", include_depth=True,
                           note="visual cabinet transfer")
        pos = eef(res)
    # Place on the cabinet shelf, open, and hold the final state.
    res = robot.submit("ee_delta", action_rows(12, dz=-0.5, grip=1),
                       cameras=cams, video="none", include_depth=True,
                       note="lower into cabinet")
    robot.submit("ee_delta", action_rows(10, grip=-1), cameras=cams,
                 video="none", note="release in cabinet")
    robot.get_obs(cameras=cams, seconds=2.0, video="none")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run()
